title: Helping People Without Homes
text:
Many cities have a big problem with homeless people. Some people have no home, no job, and no money. They sleep on the street or in parks. Many volunteers want to help them. They give food, warm clothes, and advice.

Some people think the government should do more. They say new houses are needed for everyone. Other people think that help from friends and neighbours is important too. Maybe the best solution is to work together.

questions.text: Where do some homeless people sleep?
options: On the street or in parks

questions.text: What do some people say the government should do?
options: Close all the parks in the city
Do more, because new houses are needed for everyone

questions.text: Why do many volunteers want to help homeless people?
options: Because they care about people who have a hard life
Because they are paid a lot of money
Because the city forces them to
Because they do not like the parks

questions.text: What does the writer probably believe about the problem?
options: Only the government can ever solve it
Everyone can help solve it together
It is not a serious problem
It only happens in small villages

vocabulary.definition: people who help without being paid
words that tell someone what to do or think
the group of people who run a country

paragraph_translations: Muitas cidades têm um grande problema com pessoas sem-teto. Algumas pessoas não têm casa, nem emprego, nem dinheiro. Elas dormem na rua ou em parques. Muitos voluntários querem ajudá-las. Eles dão comida, roupas quentes e conselhos.

Algumas pessoas acham que o governo deveria fazer mais. Elas dizem que novas casas são necessárias para todos. Outras pessoas acham que a ajuda de amigos e vizinhos também é importante. Talvez a melhor solução seja trabalhar juntos.
